paper.title_en: The $χ_{c1}(3872)$ Multiplet in the Diabatic Dynamical Diquark Model
paper.abstract_en: We apply a minimal form of the diabatic dynamical diquark model, which uses only dimeson thresholds augmented by constraints obtained from heavy-quark spin symmetry, to the hidden-charm tetraquark spectrum. We find that this model is insufficient to simultaneously reproduce the experimentally established states \(χ_{c1}(3872)\), \(T_{c\bar c1}(3900)\), and \(T_{c\bar c1}(4020)\). We therefore extend the model to its complete form, by restoring the spin- and isospin-dependent diquark-antidiquark interactions from the original adiabatic dynamical diquark model into the full diabatic potential. Aligning the resulting framework to these three states allows the remaining members of the \(Σ_g^+(1S)\) multiplet to be predicted through coupled-channel scattering simulations. The resulting resonance or bound state locations lie within approximately \(10~\mathrm{MeV}\) of the corresponding pure adiabatic mass eigenvalue predictions in all cases, indicating that the adiabatic fine-structure pattern survives the inclusion of explicit dimeson channels. We also discuss possible experimental counterparts for the unconfirmed multiplet members.
